label: refusalIsSuccess: a tool its help disables is offered as enabled, so a locked Pen's P picks it
firstToolAlways: any tool letter picks the first tool, so R picks Select
shiftDropped: Shift no longer reaches a Flare or Design drag, so it can't constrain
optionDropped: Option no longer reaches a Flare or Design drag, so it can't draw from the center
commandDropped: Command no longer reaches Design's drag, so holding it doesn't turn snapping off
fieldTakesBrushKeys: a digit typed in a text field also sets the brush's opacity
find: if responder is NSText { return true }
replace: if responder is NSText { return false }

label: commandTaken: Command-[ (Send Backward) also steps the brush size down
